after_own_known_manual_cost: encumbered=C+QT+QC; target/formal counted once, closer/manual counted once. No recursive formalclose for MANUAL_ONLY closer.
after_verified_target_commit: encumbered=C+QT+RC. Target actualcharge replaces target reservation once; unused planning reservation is released as policy capacity, not measured gain. Closer own RC remains in full.
before_close: encumbered=C+max(RT,QT)+RC. QT is visible nonadditive known unclosed price; do not also add QT+RT. Require selected600/2400 cap and actual own180/1GiB scope; no source grant.
cap_failure: Known overruns charged fully, never clipped to180. Resource/receipt/cap breach remains recorded and blocks incompatible transition or future payload; no implicit extra allowance.
partial_or_unknown: No reservation release on partial commit. Unknown own body/cleanup/terminal prevents QC substitution and keeps all future NEW blocked. Target unknown prohibits METADATA_CLOSE before dispatch/phase.

symbols.C: All already closed policy charges, including fixed legacy base, excluding target and live closer.
symbols.QC: Closer later genuine measured own elapsed plus separate admin, accepted after its exit.
symbols.QT: Target genuine known adjudicated elapsed plus its separate admin; full unclipped cost.
symbols.RC: Closer original own body reservation plus separate admin.
symbols.RT: Original target body reservation plus its separate admin policy.
